entries.0a0732c3db968981: The holding company of the Morita Group, which makes and sells fire-fighting and disaster-prevention products such as fire trucks and fire extinguishers, and environmental conservation vehicles such as refuse collection trucks.
entries.38e11064926023b1: This business manufactures and sells industrial machinery and press machinery and environmental equipment, and designs and builds environmental plants. Morita Kankyo Tech Co., Ltd. is engaged in this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,476 million.
entries.3b91c16fd60d9d4e: This business manufactures and sells fire extinguishers and designs and builds fire-fighting equipment, such as fire extinguishing systems and fire alarm systems. Morita Miyata Kogyo Co., Ltd. is engaged in this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥24,959 million.
entries.874aec36f9012f6c: This business manufactures and sells environmental conservation vehicles, such as refuse collection vehicles and sanitation vehicles. Three companies, including Morita Econos Co., Ltd., are engaged in this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,469 million.
